claim: Netflix's disclosed total assets totaled $50.8 million during Q2 2023.
summary: Netflix's Q2 2023 total assets were on the order of ~$50 billion, not $50.8 million; the claimed $50.8 million understates magnitude by ~1000x and is contradicted by general knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Netflix's disclosed total assets totaled $50.8 million during Q2 2023.
sub_claims.note: General knowledge establishes Netflix total assets in 2023 were on order of ~$48-51 billion, not millions; $50.8 million is off by factor of ~1000. No tool retrieval or citations per instructions.
